steps: Took today's crisis Hormuz Convoy as the US
Approved cabinet picks most months, opened Mission panel twice, switched a crisis pick in month 3 and 11
Executed 12 months, finished all end screens
scenarios.notes: Ended A, 3 stars, 688, and I could say why (goals met, ranking, moments).

steps: Finished the whole Flashpoint without getting stuck
Went through verdict, achievements, moments, approval, numbers, truth, ranking, share card, full report

friction.happened: Three options; I chose Guide me, which opens a briefing each crisis. Briefing was good but long names list.

friction.expected: know Muscat, IRGC, Mojtaba Khamenei, Strait of Hormuz
friction.happened: Muscat appeared in the pick label without explanation; Who is who card helped for Khamenei, IRGC. Muscat/Oman never explained.

friction.where: Mission names later: Isfahan, bunker-buster, Qatari text, Congress, logistics access, UAE
friction.happened: Underlined names with i helped; Isfahan's tunnels and Bunker-busters needed the i.

friction.where: Top mission chip 'This month: approval 42%, ne...'
friction.expected: tap to see how to raise approval
friction.happened: Tapping the chip text did nothing visible; only tapping the 'Open the strait' title opened Mission. Text is truncated.

friction.expected: tapping an option name selects it
friction.happened: text tap on option title failed once, tapping the card worked; no visible selection until I scrolled up to see 'Your pick'.

friction.expected: result of the North Korea choice I made
friction.happened: Said 'Your forces gain ground against Iran' two months in a row (Feb, Mar 2027), unrelated to the choice. Felt like a repeated card.

friction.where: After Next month in some months
friction.happened: The newspaper opened full screen with a floating Next month button; my Execute tap was swallowed behind it once.
More button clipped to a chevron/cut text on 390px.
Best moment 'Spy on Iran' and 'Mobilize forces' were orders I never knowingly picked (Approve cabinet pick bundles them).
'rarity not measured yet' and everything earned at Month 12 reads like a placeholder.
Leadership 157/300 average 104 (x1.5), Finish vs par 107: spreadsheet-ish, skimmed.

bugs.title: Debrief headline repeats and does not match chosen crisis option
bugs.actual: 'Your forces gain ground against Iran' in two consecutive months

bugs.title: Header More button clipped at 4+ capital diamonds
Execute month swallowed when newspaper overlay is open
steps: Execute a month, tap Next month
Newspaper shows; tap Approve and Execute
bugs.expected: Execute works or overlay is clearly modal
bugs.actual: Month did not execute; overlay stayed

suggestions.what: Show a clear selected state on the crisis option I tapped without scrolling
Say who Oman/Muscat is in the pick label or i
Make the top mission chip tappable and untruncated
Simplify the verdict score breakdown to one line per part

delight: Wordle-style month squares and 'The record is sealed' (shots/maya-phone/040-m12x.png)
Mission panel 'Helps now' chips and 'Best for your mission' tag (shots/maya-phone/013-more.png)
Better than 81% of simulated leaders with ladder (shots/maya-phone/062-e8.png)

fun.reason: Quick loop, each month a clear decision, ended with a win.

clarity.reason: Always knew next step; goal bar and Helps now chips told me what to do.

visual.reason: Scenes, newspaper and cards looked crafted on a phone.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Cards plus verdict and share card feel like a game; approving staff picks felt a bit auto-pilot.

agency.reason: Never blocked; but debrief did not always match my choice and bundled orders were unclear.

realism.reason: Plausible news-like crises; I cannot judge deeply.

replay.reason: Replay same opening and beat 688 hook, plus daily crisis.

recommend.reason: Finished in about 20 minutes, understood why I won, would send to a friend.

verbatim: I finished it, got an A and I actually know why. The goal bar told me what helps. Only the repeated 'forces gain ground' headline and the unexplained Muscat made me squint.
